selection.edition: international Appstle Subscriptions Admin API v2
selection.ownership: Appstle Inc., Menlo Park, California, United States, with offices in Vancouver, Canada and South Asia. The reviewed edition is the international Shopify Admin API at subscription-admin.appstle.com, not a mainland-China product. Indian/Canadian offices of a US-headquartered global edition are not EXCLUDE.

research.searchCoverage: Official Appstle Subscriptions Admin API (X-API-Key to https://subscription-admin.appstle.com/api/external/v2), authentication, OpenAPI customer list/get/valid-ids/detail paths, company identity (Menlo Park, CA), and dated incident search (Appstle Subscriptions + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved platform compromise found in reviewed coverage; a Dec 2024 Shopify-app review describing a merchant migration mix-up is an operational data-handling complaint, not a platform breach. This is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Appstle Subscriptions Admin API v2
research.searchCoverage: Official Admin API uses X-API-Key against subscription-admin.appstle.com. OpenAPI documents GET /api/external/v2/subscription-contract-details/customers, GET /subscription-customers/{id}, GET /subscription-customers/valid/{customerId}, and GET /subscription-customers-detail/valid/{customerId}. Healthcheck is the pinned credential validator (page=0&size=1), not a billed prediction. Operator is Appstle Inc., Menlo Park, CA. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved platform compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-contract-details/customers?page=0&size=1, matching the pinned validator. Native returns raw JSON under data rather than the upstream {customers} wrapper. Official OpenAPI models pageable as a required object; native sends Spring page/size query params as the pinned source does.

Returns raw Appstle JSON under data. Optional name/email/activeMoreThanOneSubscription/page/size bind to documented query names. sort array is omitted because a native query template cannot repeat sort the way the pinned source appends each directive. When page/size are unset native omits them; pinned source defaults page=0 and size=25.
Official OpenAPI path parameter is {id}; native uses {{customerId}} to match the pinned source. Optional cursor binds as query. Returns raw JSON under data rather than {customer}.
Maps to official GET /api/external/v2/subscription-customers/valid/{customerId}. Returns the raw integer array under data rather than {contractIds}.

Maps to official GET /api/external/v2/subscription-customers-detail/valid/{customerId}. Returns raw JSON under data rather than {subscriptions}. Storefront analog paths under the shop App Proxy are omitted; this recipe uses the Admin API host only.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-contract-details. Native exposes status/page/size instead of the Spring pageable object.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-contracts/contract-external/{contractId}.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-contract-details/analytics/{contractId}.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-contract-details/current-cycle/{contractId}.
Maps to PUT /api/external/v2/subscription-contracts-update-status with contractId and status query params.
Maps to PUT /api/external/v2/subscription-contracts-update-billing-date.
Maps to DELETE /api/external/v2/subscription-contracts/{id}.
Maps to PUT /api/external/v2/subscription-billing-attempts/skip-order/{id}.
Maps to PUT /api/external/v2/subscription-billing-attempts/unskip-order/{id}.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/product-swaps.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/product-swaps/{id}.
Maps to POST /api/external/v2/product-swaps. Native sends shop, name, and variant fields.
Maps to DELETE /api/external/v2/product-swaps/{id}.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-groups.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-groups/{id}.
Maps to GET /api/external/v2/subscription-groups/all-selling-plans.
